text: Sebastien Taveau recounts a career helping turn ambitious technology ideas into products, including work connected with PayPal Mobile and Zelle. Blending professional recollections with practical lessons, he focuses on the people behind the scenes who make a company's vision achievable. The book examines the value of finding one's strengths, working with capable teams, and learning from setbacks while building a satisfying career in technology.
author: Sebastien Taveau
